title: Complete the gap inversion - compiler consumes gaps instead of synthesizing them
description: WHY: the epic's target was directives as projections of enforcement, with the compiler reduced to look up gap code, fill data, order by severity. What landed is a half-inversion: the public interface is gap-shaped (selectAgentDirectiveRegistryEntriesFromGaps) but agentDirectiveGapsForSnapshot (packages/core/src/agent-directive-compiler.ts line 737) synthesizes gaps from snapshots via triggerCodesForSnapshot plus dataActivatesRegistryEntry - a hand-rolled per-registry-id matcher that recreates the appliesTo problem one layer down, with its own duplicate trigger table (DATA_TRIGGER_CODES around line 228). Net directive-system line count grew from 3916 to 4111 (compiler 1369 to 1583, snapshot assembler unchanged at 622). Two rule systems again means drift again - the sibling stale-obligation bug is the first instance. WHAT: (1) move gap derivation for the snapshot-only families (memory, handoff, workflow_next, sprint launch, rollups) into the code that owns their state, emitting gaps as typed data the CLI passes to the compiler, mirroring how closeout gaps already flow from the engine; (2) delete agentDirectiveGapsForSnapshot, dataActivatesRegistryEntry and DATA_TRIGGER_CODES once no caller synthesizes; (3) shrink the snapshot assembler to the fields directives actually render; (4) report before and after line counts in the closeout summary. If a family genuinely cannot emit from owned state, record the exception and its reason in the registry entry rather than keeping a silent matcher arm. Depends on the stale-obligation fix landing first so behavior parity is testable against correct output.
acceptanceCriteria: agentDirectiveGapsForSnapshot and dataActivatesRegistryEntry are deleted with all bundle tests passing against runtime-emitted gaps
Directive-system total line count decreases and the delta is reported in the closeout summary
Golden bundle tests show identical or deliberately-changed output, with changes enumerated
closedReason: directive compiler now consumes explicit enforcement gaps
